item.title: Powering the AI Boom: Why Data Center Physical Infrastructure Is Growing at Record Pace
item.summary: As hyperscalers, cloud providers, and enterprises race to deploy artificial intelligence (AI) at scale, investments are extending well beyond servers into electrical distribution, thermal management, liquid cooling, racks, containment systems, power infrastructure, and heat rejection technologies. Together, these components, collectively referred to as data center physical infrastructure (DCPI), form the foundation of AI-ready data centers, encompassing […] The post Powering the AI Boom: Why Data Center Physical Infrastructure Is Growing at Record Pace appeared first on Telecom Review Asia .
